Class Pivot

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.SmartPositionalMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.Pivot
yams.commands2.mechanisms.Pivot
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommandMechanism
public class Pivot extends Pivot implements CommandMechanism
Command-based extension of Pivot that adds the Subsystem binding and Command/Trigger factories.

Usage Example

// --- Instantiation ---
Pivot pivot = new Pivot(pivotConfig, motor);

// --- Commands ---
Command aimHigh = pivot.setAngle(Degrees.of(45));
Command stowPivot = pivot.runTo(Degrees.of(0), Degrees.of(1));

// --- Trigger bindings ---
pivot.near(Degrees.of(45), Degrees.of(2)).onTrue(shooter.runShooter());
pivot.gte(Degrees.of(55)).onTrue(Commands.print("Approaching upper limit!"));
pivot.lte(Degrees.of(5)).onTrue(Commands.print("Pivot near stow position."));

  • Constructor Details

    • Pivot

      public Pivot(PivotConfig config, SmartMotorController smc)
      Construct the Pivot class
      Parameters:
      config - Pivot configuration.
      smc - SmartMotorController driving the pivot.
      Throws:
      PivotConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the pivot lower or upper hard limit is not configured.
      PivotConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the starting position is not configured.
      PivotConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the starting position is outside the hard limits.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if smc's config does not have a Subsystem set via withSubsystem(Subsystem).
      Implementation Note:
      smc's config must be a SmartMotorControllerConfig with a Subsystem set via withSubsystem(Subsystem).
